description: Manual overrides for source features, keyed by OSM element ID. Values here are curated, not source-derived; each record states where the value came from.

landmarks.note: Manual. OSM has no height tag; 76 is the value OSM contributors recorded in the feature's 'ele' tag with the description that it follows the temple's official site. Published figures for the prang range from about 67 m to 86 m.
